key_insight: PathFM forecasts full future trajectories, not just marginal quantiles, by using flow matching to generate diverse, dependence-aware paths efficiently.
engineering_relevance: This enables practical forecasting for trajectory-dependent decisions such as demand planning, peak load management, and event timing while keeping inference fast enough for real deployment.
method: Uses a flow-matching generative model to sample complete future multivariate paths.
Distills sampling to one or two steps and reuses history attention cache across draws for speed.
Adds direct calibration-loss optimization with the distilled sampler for better probabilistic forecast quality.
evidence_signal: The paper reports competitive marginal accuracy on fev-bench and TIME, and higher aggregate path scores on the new fps-bench, which adds energy, variogram, and downstream metrics; chaotic-system experiments show improved long-run variability over baselines.
watch_item: The speed and calibration benefits rely on distillation and cache sharing, so performance may depend on careful implementation and may be less robust if the model is heavily out of distribution.
paper_title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
